// what capture.ts found: a name an action body uses, why it depends on state, and whether the checker could not follow it
export type CaptureFound = { readonly name: string; readonly why: string; readonly opaque?: boolean; readonly fix?: string };

export const captureMessage = () => (c: CaptureFound): string => c.fix !== undefined
  ? `${c.name} ${c.why}; ${c.fix}`
  : c.opaque
  ? `${c.name} ${c.why}; an action may use from its cell only inputs that hold no state and the consts and functions made from them, so pass the value to the action when it is called`
  : c.why.startsWith("capability ")
  ? `${c.name} is a capability, so an action using it would make the stored state depend on something the calls do not record; take the value as an argument of the action (a handler is called with values only by a canvas's onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onPointerUp and onPointerCancel, which give { x, y, t, id, buttons }, and an input's onInput, which gives its text; onClick gives none)`
  : `${c.name} depends on state (${c.why}), so an action using it would act on the value from the cell's last run; read the state cell inside the action with read(...), or pass the value to the action when it is called`;

export type Ast = { program: AstNode; comments: AstComment[]; src: string; count: number };

// a parse: the tree, or acorn's error as a value
export type Parse = { ok: true; ast: Ast } | { ok: false; message: string; pos: number; line: number; column: number };
export type AstKid = { key: string; node: AstNode };
export const kidOne = () => (key: string, x: AstNode | null): AstKid[] => (x === null ? [] : [{ key, node: x }]);
export const kidMany = (kidOne) => (key: string, xs: (AstNode | null)[]): AstKid[] => xs.flatMap((x) => kidOne(key, x));

export const childrenOf = (kidMany, kidsGroup1, kidsGroup2, kidsGroup3, kidsGroup4, kidsGroup5, kidsGroup6, kidsGroup7) => (n: AstNode): AstKid[] =>
  n.type === "Other" ? n.fields.flatMap((f) => kidMany(f.key, f.nodes)) : kidsGroup1(n) ?? kidsGroup2(n) ?? kidsGroup3(n) ?? kidsGroup4(n) ?? kidsGroup5(n) ?? kidsGroup6(n) ?? kidsGroup7(n) ?? [];
export const parseTree = (acornParse: (text: string, jsx: boolean) => Parse) => (text: string, jsx: boolean): Parse => acornParse(text, jsx);

// the node type as acorn names it (an Other node keeps it in kind)
export const nodeKind = () => (n: AstNode): string => (n.type === "Other" ? n.kind : n.type);
export type FnNode = ArrowFunctionExpression | FunctionExpression | FunctionDeclaration;

// the keys of type positions, which parse.ts kids leaves out
export const TYPE_FIELDS = () => new Set(["typeAnnotation", "returnType", "typeParameters", "typeArguments"]);
export type ModErr = { at: AstNode; rule: string; msg: string };
export type CellAt = { name: string; fn: FnNode; stmt: AstNode };
export type Found = { cells: CellAt[]; errors: ModErr[] };

// clashes are reported before the declarations are loaded, errors after
export type ModuleShape = { cells: CellAt[]; clashes: ModErr[]; errors: ModErr[] };

// the declaration a statement holds: `export const x = …` holds its const
export const declOf = () => (st: AstNode): AstNode => (st.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && st.declaration !== null ? st.declaration : st);

// syntax pass (core.ts syntaxPass): one list of what the walk reports, unsup for what it calls unsupported
export type SyntaxDiag = { at: AstNode; rule: string; msg: string; unsup: boolean };

// core.ts distinctNames: a name declared twice is parsed again under a stand-in of the same length, up to 40^len
export type Distinct = { parse: Parse; text: string; dups: [string, string][]; parses: number };

// the k-th stand-in of length len (Lisu letters, as core.ts STAND), or null when k needs more letters
export const STAND_INS = () => "ꓐꓑꓒꓓꓔꓕꓖꓗꓘꓙꓚꓛꓜꓝꓞꓟꓠꓡꓢꓣꓤꓥꓦꓧꓨꓩꓪꓫꓬꓭꓮꓯꓰꓱꓲꓳꓴꓵꓶꓷ";
export type IxDiag = { readonly start: number; readonly end: number; readonly rule: string; readonly msg: string };

// a persistent log, newest first, with its length
export type IxLog = { readonly d: IxDiag; readonly n: number; readonly next: IxLog | null };

// the scope ids enclosing a scope, innermost first (Scope.parent)
export type IxChain = { readonly id: number; readonly up: IxChain | null };
export type IxKind = "const" | "let" | "param" | "fn" | "global" | "prelude";

// Env without its flow: the flow of the environment in use is IxCtl.cur
export type IxEnv = { scope: number; up: IxChain | null; fi: IxFnCtx; dead: boolean };
export type IxFlow = Map<string, Ty>;

// a condition's two flows, by flow id
export type IxCond = { t: number; f: number };

// the flows at the breaks of each enclosing switch (null for a loop), innermost first
export type IxBreaks = { readonly exits: number[] | null; readonly next: IxBreaks | null };

// completion's question (lite/complete.ts): the placeholder name, and whether it is asked for as a member
export type IxProbeAsk = { readonly name: string; readonly member: boolean };
export type IxScopeName = { readonly name: string; readonly kind: IxKind; readonly t: Ty };

// at the first read of the placeholder: the names in scope there, innermost first; or the object's type at its first read as a member
export type IxProbe = { readonly k: "name"; readonly names: IxScopeName[]; readonly inAction: boolean } | { readonly k: "member"; readonly t: Ty };
export type IxFactLog = { readonly f: IxFact; readonly next: IxFactLog | null };

// CallFact: each field null when the TypeScript leaves it unset
export type IxCallFact = { readonly sig: Fn | null; readonly prelude: string | null; readonly helper: number | null };
export type IxUse = { readonly fi: number; readonly at: number; readonly rule: string; readonly msg: string };

// the expression types by nid, the bindings by "<scope>:<name>", the flows by id, the rest
export type IxTypes = Mut<Map<number, Ty>>;
export type IxVars = Mut<Map<string, IxBinding>>;
export type IxFlows = Mut<Map<number, IxFlow>>;
export type IxCtls = Mut<IxCtl>;
export type IxCompile = { k: "options"; at: AstNode } | { k: "done"; t: Ty };
export type IxOutput = { fn: Ty; diags: IxDiag[]; unsup: IxDiag[]; gap: string | null; facts: IxFacts };

// Partial<Binding> as bindPattern passes it on
export type IxExtra = { assigned: boolean; cellParam: boolean };
export const ixPush = () => (log: IxLog | null, d: IxDiag): IxLog => ({ d, n: (log?.n ?? 0) + 1, next: log });

// ---- flows ----
export const ixFlowOf = () => (W: IxFlows, id: number): IxFlow => W.get(id) ?? new Map();

// new Map(flow): a copy, which later writes to either do not reach
export const ixCopyFlow = (ixNewFlow, ixFlowOf) => (W: IxFlows, C: IxCtls, id: number): number => ixNewFlow(W, C, ixFlowOf(W, id));

// a flow key that is not a path: a path starts with "#", so no property name can produce one of these
export const ixExclusion = () => (x: string, path: string): string => `!${x} ${path}`;
export const ixPathOf = () => (key: string): string => (key.startsWith("!") ? key.slice(key.indexOf(" ") + 1) : key);
export const ixJoin2 = (ixJoin) => (W: IxFlows, C: IxCtls, a: number, b: number): number => ixJoin(W, C, a, b) ?? a;
export const ixNoExtra = (): IxExtra => ({ assigned: false, cellParam: false });

export const ixConvert = (ixTps, ixLookTable) => (K: IxK, V: IxVars, env: IxEnv, n: AstNode): Ty =>
  K.reg.convert(n, ixTps(env), K.reg.hasTypeQuery(n) ? ixLookTable(V, env) : null);
export const ixNonNullish = (ixFilter) => (R: IxRegCore, t: Ty): Ty => ixFilter(R, t, (m) => m.k !== "null" && m.k !== "undef" && m.k !== "void");
export const ixNonUndef = (ixFilter) => (R: IxRegCore, t: Ty): Ty => ixFilter(R, t, (m) => m.k !== "undef" && m.k !== "void");

export const IX_TYPEOF = (STR, NUM, BOOL, BIGINT, UNDEF, SYMBOL, OBJECT, NULL, union) => new Map<string, Ty>([["string", STR], ["number", NUM], ["boolean", BOOL], ["bigint", BIGINT], ["undefined", UNDEF],
  ["symbol", SYMBOL], ["object", union([OBJECT, NULL])], ["function", OBJECT]]);

// the runtime handles of these have none of the members their declarations give them to be nominal
export const ixMemberless = (isNamed) => (m: Ty): boolean => isNamed(m, "Action") || isNamed(m, "StateCell") || isNamed(m, "Events") || isNamed(m, "Listener");

// Action<[A, B]> called as (a0: A, a1: B) => void
export const ixActionFn = (VOID) => (args: Ty): Fn => ({ k: "fn", tps: [], ps: (args.k === "tup" ? args.els : []).map((t, i) => ({ n: "a" + i, t, opt: false })), ret: VOID });

// actionIn: the first Action held anywhere in s
export const ixActionIn = (ixHeldIn) => (R: IxRegCore, s: Ty): string | null => ixHeldIn(R, s, 0, (x) => x.k === "named" && x.n === "Action", true);

// handleIn: the first State or Events handle, or (d1, 2026-11-24) a FetchResponse, whose body can be read once
export const ixHandleIn = (ixHeldIn) => (R: IxRegCore, s: Ty): string | null => ixHeldIn(R, s, 0, (x) => x.k === "named" && (x.n === "State" || x.n === "Events" || x.n === "FetchResponse"), true);

// t has, somewhere hidden walks, unknown, object, a type parameter or a function (rgMayHide, memoised per registry core)
export const ixMayHide = () => (R: IxRegCore, t: Ty): boolean => R.mayHide(t);

export type IxHiddenFn = (H: IxHide, s: Ty, t: Ty, depth: number) => string | null;

export const ixCtxSensitive = () => (e: AstNode): boolean =>
  e.type === "ObjectExpression" || e.type === "ArrayExpression" || e.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || e.type === "FunctionExpression";

export const ixDeleteMsg = () => (bad: string, o: string): string => bad === "an element"
  ? "delete on an array element leaves a hole that reads undefined; build a new array without it (filter, toSpliced)"
  : bad.includes(" ") ? "delete takes only an optional member of a record or an entry of an index signature"
  : `delete removes ${bad}, which the type requires, so a later read finds undefined; make ${bad} optional in the type (${bad}?: …), or build a new record without it (const { ${bad}: _, ...rest } = ${o})`;

// d1 (2026-11-24): fetch gives a Mut<FetchResponse> (its body can be read once), whose members are not written
export const ixRespMut = () => (t: Ty): boolean => t.k === "named" && t.n === "Mut" && t.args.length === 1 && t.args[0]?.k === "named" && t.args[0]?.n === "FetchResponse";

// the fix a non-Mut write's message names: the method's twin that returns a new array, or a copy made where it is written

export const owPrelude = () => (O: OwCtx, c: AstNode): string | null => (c.type === "CallExpression" ? O.F.calls.get(c.nid)?.prelude ?? null : null);

export const owAdd = () => (xs: number[], id: number): number[] => (xs.includes(id) ? xs : [...xs, id]);

  owIter(O.R, b.t) !== "FetchResponse" && (owLocalHoldsMut(O, b) || (!b.cellParam && b.kind === "let" && !isPrimitive(b.t)));

// a value, not a function: no call running and nothing to commit
export const emptyStore = (): StoreState => ({ depth: 0, call: null, ready: new Map(), nextSid: 0 });
export const isIdle = () => (st: StoreState): boolean => st.call === null && st.ready.size === 0;

// the call a write or read belongs to: the top-level call, while an action's function is on the stack
export const ownerOf = () => (st: StoreState): Writes | null => (st.depth > 0 ? st.call : null);

// handle.value, legal anywhere
export const committedOf = () => (store: StoreRecord): Seen => (store.view ? { k: "view" } : { k: "value", value: store.value });

// sids are not reused: a record made before the reset may still be held
export const resetStore = (emptyStore) => (st: StoreState): StoreStep => ({ state: { ...emptyStore, nextSid: st.nextSid }, effects: [] });
export type Key = string | number;

// a checked cell's prop is an attribute value or an action; render.ts passes an unchecked cell's props as they are
export type PropValue = string | number | boolean | null | undefined | ((...a: never[]) => unknown);
export type Props = { readonly [k: string]: PropValue };

// a new child: an element h made (its tag and key), or any other value, drawn as this text
export type Kid = { readonly k: "elem"; readonly tag: string; readonly key: Key | undefined } | { readonly k: "text"; readonly text: string };

// a DOM child as render.ts found it: one it drew as an element (the tag it was created for), a text node, or a node it did not make
export type Drawn = Kid | { readonly k: "other" };

// an attribute value that removes the attribute
export const removesAttribute = () => (v: PropValue): boolean => v === false || v === null || v === undefined;

// an attribute is written again only for a value that is not the one before (identity, as for an action)
export const sameAttribute = () => (was: PropValue, value: PropValue): boolean => (typeof value === "function" ? Object.is(was, value) : was === value);

// a key and tag as one string, as the renderer compares them: key 1 and key "1" are the same key
export const slotId = () => (tag: string, key: Key): string => `${tag}:${key}`;
export const drawnId = (slotId) => (d: Drawn): string | null => (d.k === "elem" && d.key !== undefined ? slotId(d.tag, d.key) : null);

// a node is patched in place for a new element of the tag it was created for (a child here, a root in mount)
export const keepsNode = () => (cur: Drawn, kid: Kid): boolean => cur.k === "elem" && kid.k === "elem" && cur.tag === kid.tag;
export type UnionShape = { k: "union"; ts: Shape[] };

// a union of records that each give the property key a literal of their own: the member for each literal
export type Dispatch = { readonly key: string; readonly by: Map<string | number | boolean, Shape> };
export type FnShape = { k: "fn"; ps: Shape[]; ret: Shape; async: boolean };

// what a wrapper checks on each call: each argument's shape and path, and the result's path
export type FnPlan = { readonly args: readonly { readonly shape: Shape; readonly path: string }[]; readonly result: string };

// a value at path that does not fit s; with no shape, found is the whole message (a cycle)
export const mismatchText = (want) => (path: string, s: Shape | null, found: string): string => (s !== null ? `${path}: expected ${want(s)}, found ${found}` : `${path}: ${found}`);

// under a recursive shape a path longer than 300 characters keeps its two ends
export const trimPath = () => (path: string, recursive: boolean): string => (recursive && path.length > 300 ? `${path.slice(0, 80)}…${path.slice(-160)}` : path);

// what a function wrapper checks on each call
export const fnPlan = () => (name: string, s: FnShape): FnPlan => ({ args: s.ps.map((shape, i) => ({ shape, path: `${name} argument ${i + 1}` })), result: `${name}(...)` });

// a throw from the function, or while its result is read: what stands for it
export const thrownText = () => (name: string, what: string, m: string): string => `${name}(...)${what}: ${m}`;

// the shape element i of an array is checked against: an array's element shape, a tuple's i-th, data under unknown
export const elemShape = () => (s: Shape, i: number): Shape => (s.k === "arr" ? s.el : s.k === "tup" ? s.els[i] ?? s : s);
